body: <gradient:red:purple>LANVEX</gradient> SMP is a community-focused Minecraft server built to fight against pay-to-win gameplay. The server runs on powerful hardware and fast internet.

One of the unique parts of <gradient:red:purple>LANVEX</gradient> is its heavy use of the <accent>Skript</accent> language, which powers many of the server's custom features and systems. In the future, players will even be able to create their own worlds, play with friends, and build custom minigames using <accent>Skript</accent>.

items.question: What versions of Minecraft are supported?
items.answer: We support the latest version of Minecraft Java Edition as well as Bedrock Edition. You can connect using the IP play.lancsmp.ru.

items.question: Is the server pay-to-win?
items.answer: Absolutely not! Our core principle is to provide a fair, balanced experience for all players. We don't sell power-ups, advantages, or anything that breaks game balance.

items.question: What is Skript?
items.answer: Skript is a plugin that lets you create custom Minecraft features using simple scripts. It powers many of our server's unique mechanics, and in the future you'll even be able to use it to create your own worlds and minigames!

items.question: How do I report a player or issue?
items.answer: Join our Discord server and use the support channels to report any issues or rule-breaking behavior. Our staff team will review and handle it promptly.

items.question: Can I create my own world or minigame?
items.answer: Yes! This is one of our upcoming features. Players will soon be able to create their own worlds and build custom minigames using <accent>Skript</accent>, playing together with friends in their own unique spaces.
